'''Espo Armor''' was the standard issue [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn by members of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]]. It consisted of a [[Color/Legends|brown]] padded [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] with an impact-resistant [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]].

==Characteristics==
The armor was primarily geared towards protecting the security officer from physical impacts rather than energy blasts, as a shot from a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] could punch right through it. The visored helmet included a retractable breathing filter and headset [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], as well as headphone hearing protection.
